messages.subject: start-up
parts:
I like rattle, but I don't use it all the time. How do I remove it
from automatically attaching when I start R? There is nothing about
rattle that I see in .Renviron.site

Thanks!

messages.author: 8caf9e9fc35f0eed
messages.subject: Re: start-up
parts:
It's probably in your .Rprofile or (I'm not sure about this one)
in .Rdata. Those also get auto-magically loaded on startup
(the .Rprofile for sure).

As your subect suggests:

?Startup

> I like rattle, but I don't use it all the time. How do I remove it

messages.author: 51ea28fc190ac537
messages.subject: Re: start-up
parts:
Hi Jim,

You are correct that Rattle should not be doing that - nothing in Rattle would cause that to happen (as best I know). 

Do you have a .RData file in your folder (this is saved when you exit from R and choose to save the workspace)? Do you get the same behaviour if you start up R in a different folder? I don't think it would be in any .Rprofile unless you specifically put it there.

Regards,
Graham

messages.author: 51ea28fc190ac537
messages.subject: Re: start-up
parts:
Hi Jim,

The .RData file is saved when you exit R. R usually asks if you want to save the workspace, on exiting. I would recommend always answering No. If you answer Yes, then the whole workspace, including Rattle, is saved to the .RData file. 

When you startup R again, it loads up this workspace, hence you get Rattle being loaded also. 

I would simply remove (or rename) the .RData file.

Regards,
Graham
